full_judgment: 6. This Civil suit was partly decreed and disposed of by judgment and decree dated 28.2.89. The learned Assistant Judge held in the said judgment that the PDB was not entitled to claim payment of any bill from the appellant from 5.5.85 but the appellant was liable to pay electric bills from 10.10.85. The learned Assistant Judge found that the appellant had admitted in his application to the defendants dated 7.5.87 (Ext. B) that he had taken electric connection to his rice mill unauthorisedly after it had been disconnected by the PDB for non-payment of electric bills. The appellant was, therefore, liable to pay electric bills for the said period at a penal rate.
